text.text_excerpt: It's a given that the fried chicken in New Orleans is exceptional. So while there, I especially wanted to try a local restaurant that we couldn't find elsewhere. After some research, my friend suggested Fiorella's and I'm SO GLAD we came here. Not only was the fried chicken absolute PERFECTION, but I got to try something I'd really wanted to - crispy fried soft shell crab! It was soooo good!! That is, until we hit the middle and ate the guts - NOT. GOOD. We researched later & realized we should've cut that part out (although some ppl just eat it), so have noted it for next time! Other than that one bite, everything was amazing! Oh! A special mention for their staff who were all SUPER nice...

I finally managed to try Fiorella's fried chicken! I'm really excited about the location on Franklin because it's really close to my house now. I popped in for lunch today and had to order the fried chicken. I got the two piece with house salad and potato salad as my two sides. I was pleasantly surprised at the price: $6.95. I placed my order and waited for the famous chicken with the house salad keeping me busy. When the chicken came out, I was still finishing my salad, and when I finally got to the chicken, it was still piping hot. The outside was deliciously crispy and the meat on the inside juicy. On the day I was here it was pouring rain, which normally wouldn't be an issue but there is VERY limited parking at this location, so I actually had to park across the street and trudge through puddles to get here. Hey, I had a craving for fried chicken and I was willing to do anything necessary to satisfy it. This place is pretty basic: order at the counter, get your number and they'll bring you your food. I was lucky that I beat the lunch crowd (seriously, the line was out the door about 5 minutes after I ordered) and I was able to order at the counter immediately upon walking in.
